summary: Preserve the distinction between a rejected fetch Promise and a synthetic Response.error() object.

semantics.fetch_failure: promise rejects, generally with TypeError for a network error at the JS API boundary
semantics.response_error: Response.error() is a Response object and is not what fetch returns on network failure
semantics.http_error: HTTP 4xx/5xx is not a network error

tests.name: unsupported scheme rejects
tests.input: try { await fetch("ftp://example.com/"); } catch(e) { console.log(e instanceof TypeError); }
tests.expected_behavior: prints true in a Fetch host that does not support ftp
